reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (branch_renamed seed 1 resolves to 'merge', which accepts ['merge'], but the program implements 'rename'); firing where a sibling resolution is correct is the mismatch this gate exists to refuse

refused_program.intent: Upstream renamed its default branch, so the fork's local branch no longer follows it; prune the stale remote-tracking ref, rename the local branch to upstream's new name, and make it track that branch again.

preconditions.description: no staged, unstaged or untracked change could be disturbed

preconditions.description: the checked-out branch still carries the pre-rename name

preconditions.description: no local branch already occupies upstream's new name

preconditions.description: upstream's renamed branch is already known as a remote-tracking ref
